sampled_retention.accounting_note: Only the 87 attempt-014 episodes are newly executed here, including the repeated update-2000 evaluation. The 138 combined scene checks reuse historical evidence and count update 2000 once.
sampled_retention.scope: Success and failure refer to the fixed sampled physical evaluations, not every intervening optimizer update or unseen scenes.

limitations: Every dense sentinel is evaluated at a fixed demonstrated state, which may not be visited by the current greedy policy.
Reference-state rank reversals between scheduled checkpoints do not establish actual rollout failure or its exact onset.
Success at all sampled checkpoints cannot establish success at unsampled updates or on unseen scenes.
The known successful step-24 action mismatch is retained as a control, together with every successful or failed first divergence.
This analysis performs no environment reset, environment step, optimizer update or counterfactual rescue.
